* Willis Johnson is the founder of Dallas-based Copart, a leader in online auctions for used and totaled cars; he owns about 6% of the stock.
* Johnson founded the company out of a single lot in Vallejo, California in 1982 after several years operating a dismantling yard near Sacramento.
* He took the company public in 1994 and expanded across the country; Copart now has more than 200 locations in 11 countries.
* Johnson stepped down as CEO in 2010 and handed over the reins to his son-in-law, Jay Adair, who first joined Copart in 1989 at age 19.

# Copart's Board of Directors

Willis Johnson

### Willis Johnson

* * *

In 1982, Willis founded Copart with a single auction facility in Vallejo, California. He has served as chairman of our board of directors since January 2004. From 1982 until February 2010, he served as Chief Executive Officer and from 1986 until 1995, he also served as President. Willis was an officer and director of U-Pull-It, Inc., a self-service auto dismantler, which he co-founded, from 1982 until 1994 when he sold his interest in the company.

...

Willis brings institutional history and industry expertise to our board.

Jay Adair CEO

### Jay Adair

* * *

Jay Adair serves as the Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Copart. Jay joined Copart as Manager of Operations in 1989 at the age of 19, teaming up with company founder and current Chairman of the Board Willis Johnson. He was soon promoted to Vice President of Sales and Operations in 1990, and then to Executive Vice President in 1995. Jay was appointed to Copart’s Board of Directors in 1992. He was promoted to President of Copart in 1996 and became the company’s CEO in 2010. His invigorating leadership style has established Copart as an industry leader in online vehicle auctions.
